name: ERA Realty
summary: Established agency brand with islandwide residential coverage for rentals and purchases — insist on stamped TAs and clear ABSD maths.
body: ERA agents frequently appear in expat rental searches and purchase shortlists. For rentals, ask specifically about HDB eligibility if that is on your shortlist — rules trip up newcomers weekly. Refuse any pitch that says stamp duty is optional on a residential tenancy; IRAS lease duty is usually 0.4% of total rent for leases up to four years, and silence in the TA defaults liability to the tenant. For purchases, insist the agent state your ABSD rate by nationality on the OTP date, whether FTA remission applies (US / Iceland / Liechtenstein / Norway / Switzerland), and that ABSD is cash not loanable. Interview the individual agent on contract hygiene and response time; logo scale is not a substitute for a clean LOI/OTP process.
